title: TaskDAG
description: Planner output: a directed acyclic graph of tasks with dependencies, fork points, expected verification, and destructiveness flags (Doc 04 §2). Generated with structured outputs and validated before execution.

base_checkpoint_id.description: Immutable checkpoint the whole plan forks from. Runs never execute against mutable current files.

kind.description: Task kind from the supported stack's vocabulary. Determines the tool allowlist and the verification floor; the planner may raise verification but never lower it (P2-6).

dag_parents.description: Node ids this task depends on. Empty means it may start from the base checkpoint. Cycles are rejected by the validator, not the schema.

fork_checkpoint_id.description: Green checkpoint this task's CoW fork is taken from. Omitted means the plan's base checkpoint.

expected_verification.description: Verification layers that must be green for this task. Cheap layers gate expensive ones.

destructive.description: True if the task deletes data, alters production schema, deploys, spends money, writes externally, or rotates secrets. True forces a human confirmation gate (I7).

destructive_reason.description: Required when destructive is true; shown to the human in the gate prompt.

budget.description: Every loop is bounded (I12). Omitted fields inherit the Run-level budget.
